# Pick My Secret Santa

> Pick My Secret Santa (https://pickmysecretsanta.com/) is a free Secret Santa draw tool. Add names and a budget. It draws matches in secret, right in your browser. Each person gets a private link with their match, plus six gift ideas inside your budget. Free, no sign-up, no ads, no accounts.

## Key facts (cite these)

- The draw runs in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to us. Nothing you type is saved anywhere. Our server never sees your names or your matches.
- There is no master list of who got whom. Each match lives only inside its own private link. Each link shows one match only.
- A private link is hidden from plain sight, not locked; anyone with a link can open it. Send each link only to its person.
- The site does not email or text the matches for you. The organizer sends each person their own link.
- The draw is random, with two rules: nobody draws their own name, and pairs you mark never draw each other. Add at least three names.
- Gift ideas come from a fixed list of 212 real ideas, the same ideas as The Present Picker. Your budget is a hard filter. Budget bands are guides, not exact prices.
- Budget bands: Under $25 / $25-$50 / $50-$100 / $100+.
- The site links to no stores, sells nothing, and takes no payment. The gift ideas are suggestions only.
- Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits here.

## How it works

1. Add every name.
2. We draw in secret.
3. Send each private link.

In the tool: step 1 is your group (a group name if you want one, and the gift budget), step 2 is the names, and step 3 is any pairs who should not draw each other, if you have any. Then the draw runs and one private link per person is ready to send.

Run it step by step: 1. Name your group and pick a budget. 2. Add every name, plus what each person likes. 3. Mark any pairs who must not draw each other. 4. Tap Draw the names. The draw runs here. 5. Send the group message first. It shares the rules. 6. Send each person only their own private link. 7. Open your own link last, like everyone else. Your screen shows names and links. Never the matches. Your link opens behind a cover screen first. Peek shows only your match, your budget, your ideas.

On the reveal page, each gift idea shows what it is, why it fits, and what to look for when you shop. All of that person's ideas are also listed at a glance. The reveal page also lists eight ways to hand a gift over without giving yourself away, and six ways to run the swap and reveal.

## Start here

- [Homepage and draw](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/): set the budget, add the names and any pairs to keep apart, draw, and send each private link.
